333-6495-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-6495-8207.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
333-6495-8207.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
1734-2150-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

372-1621-2072.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

372-7174-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-7174-7487.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Activate Cavern Harpy by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

Repeat.

When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 3.

628-3967-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-3967-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Boros Garrison and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Boros Garrison and another land.

277-1479-2783-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-2783-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

645-1267-5147-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

413-1794-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
413-1794-4424.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ruthless Ripper.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
When Ruthless Ripper enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
